title: Vampire Vape Desserts Raspberry Ripple Ice Cream 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Raspberry Ripple Ice Cream by Vampire Vape Desserts Koncept range delivers the nostalgic taste of creamy vanilla ice cream swirled with sweet and tangy Raspberry sauce. This dessert-inspired e-liquid blends smooth, velvety ice cream with a rich fruity swirl, offering a satisfying sweet-tart contrast that recalls a timeless summer treat. Blended at 70% VG to 30% PG, this high-VG shortfill is ideal for sub-ohm vaping, producing dense vapour and a rich, flavourful inhale. Supplied as 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid in a 120ml bottle, there’s space for two 10ml nicotine shots to customise the strength. Proudly made in the UK and fully TPD-compliant, Raspberry Ripple Ice Cream is part of the Vampire Vape Desserts collection — a range of sweet, comforting e-liquid blends inspired by classic dessert and beverage flavours. Also available in Freebase 10mls and Concentrates for DIY mixing.
